modeReason: Two stories clear the relevance threshold on their own: Anthropic's record IPO (novelty 2 × magnitude 3 × breadth 2 = 12) and a state's AI safety law taking effect (novelty 3 × magnitude 2 × breadth 2 = 12), both well above the fresh threshold of 8.
phrase: A top AI lab debuted at a $1.4 trillion valuation today, warning of 'catastrophic' AI risks. A new state law also began, asking AI firms to report their mistakes.
phraseAlternatives: A chatbot maker's stock market debut valued it near $1.4 trillion today. The same day, a new state law started requiring AI firms to report serious mistakes.
One AI lab's IPO priced it at up to $1.4 trillion, even as its own filing calls AI risk 'catastrophic.' A new AI safety law took effect the same day.
Billions poured into one AI company's stock debut today. Meanwhile, a new rule quietly asked AI makers to start reporting when things go wrong.

brief.concept: A company climbs a tower of coins into the sky for the biggest AI stock debut yet, a small tag on its side reading 'catastrophic.' Right beside it, a government stamps a fresh rulebook onto two AI labs' doors, on the very same day.
brief.metaphor: Going public and getting policed, in the very same frame.

a warning tag dangling off the building's side, its small print reading CATASTROPHIC

a human official standing beside the stamped doors, checking a box on a clipboard

brief.composition: Left half: a company building rides a rising stack of golden coins toward the top of the frame, an IPO flag on its roof and a CATASTROPHIC tag dangling off one corner. Right half, same ground line: a government building presses a round rulebook stamp down onto two smaller company doors, with a human official beside it checking a clipboard. A thin dotted vertical line separates the two halves.
brief.alt: On one side, a company building rides a tower of coins marked IPO into the sky, a small tag reading CATASTROPHIC dangling off it. On the other, a government building stamps a rulebook seal onto two smaller company doors while an official checks a clipboard.
